Carl / team — attaching our suggested redline and a short summary of the substantive changes we propose. Key notes:

- Audit access: Redwood can accommodate a time-bound on-site or remote audit with mutually agreed scope; we will not provide unrestricted access to production keys or raw customer data. We propose a 30-day notice window and an agreed evidence table.
- Subprocessors: we list cloud infra, managed DB, metrics service, and a monitoring agent. For each, we include a country of processing and a contact.
- Cross-border transfers: we rely on standard contractual clauses where applicable; we also provide technical controls (encryption at rest + in transit) and KMS integration details.

Please see attachments: DPA_Redline_karthik_20270411.docx (tracked), Redlines_summary.txt. Also attaching a short subprocessor export in CSV to speed your DPIA mapping.

We will provide links to the SOC2 and pen test summary in a follow-up email to control distribution.

Regards,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
